title: Run Checkpoint
$comment: Atomicity contract (KTD2): a checkpoint is written to `<path>.tmp`, fsynced, then renamed to `<path>`, so a reader never observes a partial write — the file at `<path>` is always either the previous complete checkpoint or the new complete one, never a half-written one. stateHash lets a reader detect that the embedded runState was tampered with out of band.
